about: Named camera moves for engine/camera.js. recipe is a JS expression in scope { M: camera.js module, W: world handles } returning a Move; duration is the usable range (stretch with M.retime). See docs/shots/catalog.md.
handles: W.hero W.object W.doc W.tower W.towerTop W.towerBox W.office W.window W.screen W.gap W.ridge W.weave W.road W.plaza W.planet W.globe W.car W.carAt(t) W.figure W.figureAt(t) W.figureHead(t) (projects/shot-lab/world-handles.mjs)

EST.name: Establishing and scale
EST.about: Where are we, and how big is it. Open chapters and sections; reset geography after a run of closes.

REV.name: Reveal
REV.about: Withhold, then show. The move itself delivers the information: a payoff, a twist, the answer to an open loop.

FOL.name: Follow and tracking
FOL.about: The camera is locked to a moving subject (Fincher): the audience rides with intent, momentum and chase.

ONE.name: Oner and bridge
ONE.about: Continuous moves that link two scenes or two scales without a cut (Cuarón/Lubezki "elastic" shots, Powers of Ten).

CHR.name: Character and silhouette
CHR.about: A person as a shape against light: intimacy, isolation, the stoic operator. No CG faces, ever.

OBJ.name: Object and macro
OBJ.about: Evidence. One object in a void or on a surface, read by a slow, close, motivated camera.

DAT.name: Data and map
DAT.about: Numbers, places and systems: maps that the camera flies to, globes, god's-eye patterns, diagrams.

TRN.name: Transition camera
TRN.about: Moves designed to cut on: whips, push-ins into darkness, match moves, velocity hand-offs between shots.

END.name: Ending
END.about: Let it land. Pull-outs, holds, rises and fades that close a chapter or the film and leave a question.

shots.recipe: M.descendFromSky({ ground: W.office, center: W.planet.center, radius: W.planet.radius, h0: 120000, h1: 220, heading: [0, 0, -1], mm: 50, dur: 8 })

shots.name: Isometric drift
shots.use: A high three-quarter drift over a model: the whole system at once, calm.
shots.recipe: M.truck({ target: W.plaza, dist: 260, az: 45, el: 35, track: 50, parallel: 1, mm: 85, dur: 9 })

shots.name: Map dive to the street
shots.use: Fly the map, then dive into the street at the destination: the data lands in a life.
shots.recipe: M.seq([M.mapFlyTo({ from: { at: [-300, 200], width: 1200 }, to: { at: [26, -26], width: 180 }, ease: 'in', dur: 6 }), M.descendFromSky({ ground: W.office, h0: 150, h1: 20, heading: [0.2, 0, -1], lookEnd: W.window.point, ease: 'out', dur: 5 })], { overlap: 1.5 })

shots.name: Orbiting data monolith
shots.use: Orbit a single tall data object (a bar, a stack of cash): one big number.
shots.recipe: M.orbit({ target: W.tower, dist: 110, az: 60, arc: 50, el0: -4, el1: 8, lookY: 10, mm: 35, dur: 8 })

shots.name: Flow-line follow
shots.use: Ride along a line of flow (money, data, goods) from source to sink.

shots.name: Pie-down top shot
shots.use: Top-down onto a circular diagram while it spins: share, division, the cut.
shots.recipe: M.godRotate({ target: W.plaza, h0: 45, h1: 38, yaw: 0, spin: 45, mm: 40, dur: 7 })

shots.name: Exploded view push
shots.use: Push into the gap between separated parts: how it works inside.
shots.recipe: M.flyThrough({ gap: [64, 6, -58], dir: [0, 0, -1], before: 30, after: 18, rise: 4, mm: 28, dur: 6 })

shots.name: Counter hold with drift
shots.use: A near-static hold for a counter or a number card: lets the number tick on its word.
shots.recipe: M.lockOff({ target: W.screen.point, dist: 9, az: 0, el: 1, mm: 50, drift: 0.01, dur: 6 })

shots.name: Globe-to-map unwrap
shots.use: Fly low over the globe until it reads as a flat map: zoom from world to country.
shots.recipe: M.globeFly({ center: W.globe.center, radius: W.globe.radius, from: { lat: 20, lon: -20, alt: 26 }, to: { lat: 45, lon: 10, alt: 0.8 }, tilt: 15, mm: 35, dur: 8 })

shots.name: Whip pan out
shots.use: Exit a shot with an eased whip; the next shot enters with the same direction (Edgar Wright).
shots.recipe: M.whipPan({ pos: [12, 1.7, 22], from: W.hero, yaw0: 0, yaw1: -120, to: null, mm: 35, dur: 0.6 })

shots.name: Whip pan in
shots.use: Enter a shot at the end of a whip and settle on the subject.
shots.recipe: M.whipPan({ pos: [12, 1.7, 22], from: W.tower, to: W.hero, mm: 35, dur: 0.7, ease: 'snap' })

shots.name: Push into black
shots.use: Push into a dark surface until the frame is black: a hidden cut (Hitchcock's Rope).
shots.recipe: M.dollyIn({ target: M.vec.add(W.hero, [0, 0, 0]), dist: 6, az: 200, el: 0, push: 0.85, mm: 35, dur: 4, ease: 'in' })

shots.name: Pull out of black
shots.use: The incoming half of a hidden cut: start black on a surface and pull away.
shots.recipe: M.dollyOut({ target: W.hero, dist: 1.2, az: 200, el: 0, pull: 6, mm: 35, dur: 4, ease: 'out' })

shots.name: Match-move exit
shots.use: Leave moving (velocity carried out) so the next shot can enter at the same speed.
shots.recipe: M.truck({ target: W.hero, dist: 16, az: 20, track: 12, mm: 35, dur: 4, ease: 'in' })
shots.note: Pair with a shot built with ease: 'out' moving the same screen direction; the cut feels like one move.

shots.name: Match-move entry
shots.use: Enter at speed and settle: the second half of a velocity match cut.
shots.recipe: M.truck({ target: W.office, dist: 40, az: -10, track: 20, mm: 35, dur: 4, ease: 'out' })

shots.name: Rise-out to the sky
shots.use: Tilt up and away into the sky: the scene releases; time passes.

shots.name: Descend-in from the sky
shots.use: Tilt down from the sky into the next scene: we have arrived somewhere new.
shots.recipe: M.tiltUp({ pos: [40, 4, 40], from: [-60, 120, -260], to: W.office, mm: 28, dur: 5 })

shots.name: Foreground wipe pass
shots.use: A dark object crosses lens: a natural wipe to hide a cut (1917, Birdman).
shots.recipe: M.truck({ target: M.vec.add(W.hero, [0, 0, 0]), dist: 9, az: 230, el: 2, track: 14, parallel: 0.2, mm: 28, dur: 3 })

shots.name: Snap zoom out
shots.use: An eased crash zoom out: comic or brutal context, the joke or the scale.
shots.recipe: M.snapZoom({ target: W.hero, dist: 30, az: 20, el: 5, mm: 135, mm1: 24, dur: 0.9 })

shots.name: Graphic-match orbit landing
shots.use: Orbit to land the subject at a planned screen point and size, to match-cut to a twin.
shots.recipe: M.seq([M.orbit({ target: W.hero, dist: 15, az: -30, arc: 40, el: 6, dur: 4, ease: 'in' }), M.hold(M.frameSubject({ center: W.hero, size: [6, 2.6, 2.4] }, { thirds: 'center', lens: 50, az: 10, el: 6, fill: 0.3 }).state, 2)], { overlap: 1.2 })
shots.note: frameSubject puts the hero at an exact screen position; frame the next shot's subject with the same opts.

shots.name: Push-in to the lens flare
shots.use: Push toward the key light until it blooms: a light-dissolve into the next scene.
shots.recipe: M.dollyIn({ target: M.vec.add(W.carAt(7.2), [2.3, 0, 0.65]), dist: 9, az: 85, el: 1, push: 0.8, mm: 40, dur: 4, ease: 'in' })

shots.name: Roll-through
shots.use: A 90-degree roll as the camera pushes: disorientation into a dream, memory or a twist.
shots.recipe: M.dutchDrift({ target: W.hero, dist: 14, az: 30, el: 3, roll0: 0, roll: 90, push: 0.4, mm: 28, dur: 3, ease: 'whip' })

shots.name: Time-lapse lock-off
shots.use: Locked frame for a time jump while the world moves (light, traffic): time passes.
shots.recipe: M.lockOff({ target: [10, 2, 12], dist: 50, az: 50, el: 8, mm: 35, drift: 0, dur: 5 })
shots.note: Run the world clock fast (scene.update(t * 20)) while the camera stays locked.

shots.name: Look-away pan
shots.use: The camera looks away from the subject at the end of a scene; the next scene starts on what it found.
shots.recipe: M.pan({ pos: [6, 1.7, 14], from: W.hero, to: W.screen.point, mm: 35, dur: 4 })

shots.name: Flash-cut hold
shots.use: A 1 s locked frame designed to sit between two flash frames: the hard tonal shift.
shots.recipe: M.lockOff({ target: W.hero, dist: 10, az: -25, el: 5, mm: 40, drift: 0.004, dur: 1.2 })

shots.name: Speed-ramp exit
shots.use: A move that accelerates out of the shot: sling into the next scene.
shots.recipe: M.speedRamp(M.dollyIn({ target: W.hero, dist: 18, az: 10, push: 0.5, dur: 4, ease: 'linear' }), [[0, 0], [0.4, 0.4], [1, 2.2]])

shots.name: Orbit hand-off between subjects
shots.use: Orbit one subject until a second lines up behind it; the orbit continues around the second.
shots.recipe: M.seq([M.orbit({ target: W.hero, dist: 14, az: 90, arc: 60, el: 6, dur: 4, ease: 'in' }), M.orbit({ target: W.office, dist: 46, az: 160, arc: 40, el: 8, dur: 5, ease: 'out' })], { overlap: 2 })

shots.name: Final pull to orbit
shots.use: One person, one city, one planet: the last image of the film.
shots.recipe: M.pullBackToPlanet({ ground: W.plaza, center: W.planet.center, radius: W.planet.radius, h0: 8, h1: 420000, heading: [0, 0, -1], spin: 30, mm: 35, dur: 12 })

shots.name: Long hold, slow creep
shots.use: Let the last line land on a near-static frame (Deakins: holding builds tension).
shots.recipe: M.creep({ target: W.hero, dist: 14, az: -25, el: 4, push: 0.06, mm: 50, dur: 10 })

shots.name: Rise and leave
shots.use: Crane up and away from the subject: the story releases it.
shots.recipe: M.craneUp({ target: W.hero, dist: 18, az: 30, el: 6, rise: 40, back: 0.5, mm: 28, dur: 9 })

shots.name: Walk-off hold
shots.use: The figure walks out of a held frame and leaves it empty: absence.
shots.recipe: M.lockOff({ target: [-2, 1.4, 6.5], dist: 16, az: -10, el: 3, mm: 40, drift: 0.008, dur: 8 })

shots.name: Window light-out
shots.use: Hold on the lit window until the light goes out: the last decision, the end of an era.
shots.recipe: M.creep({ target: W.window.point, dist: 30, az: 5, el: -8, push: 0.05, mm: 65, dur: 9 })
shots.note: Animate the window light off on the last word.

shots.name: Pull-back into the dark
shots.use: Pull back until the subject is a small lit island in black: isolation, the cost.
shots.recipe: M.pullBackReveal({ target: W.hero, dist: 10, pull: 6, rise: 25, mm: 35, dur: 10 })

shots.name: Car drives into the distance
shots.use: The car leaves along the road while the camera rises: the journey continues without us.
shots.recipe: M.lookAt(M.craneUp({ target: W.carAt(6), dist: 10, az: -100, el: 4, rise: 14, back: 0.3, mm: 35, dur: 8 }), W.car, { lead: 0.3, lag: 0.8, weight: 0.7 })

shots.name: Globe turn into night
shots.use: Orbit the globe until the place turns into the night side: time, consequence.
shots.recipe: M.orbit({ target: W.globe.center, dist: 38, az: -120, arc: 70, el: 18, mm: 35, dur: 10 })

shots.name: Closing tilt-up to the sky
shots.use: End on the sky: open, unresolved, the question left hanging.

shots.name: Circle and settle
shots.use: A last slow orbit that comes to rest on the hero angle: the definitive image.
shots.recipe: M.orbit({ target: W.hero, dist: 16, az: -50, arc: 70, el0: 12, el1: 4, mm: 40, dur: 10, ease: 'settle' })

shots.name: Top-down rise to pattern
shots.use: Lift away overhead until the subject dissolves into the pattern of everything.
shots.recipe: M.godRotate({ target: W.hero, h0: 12, h1: 320, spin: 30, mm: 35, dur: 10, ease: 'settle' })

shots.name: Dolly back from the figure
shots.use: Leave the figure where they stand, pulling back down the street: we go, they stay.
shots.recipe: M.dollyOut({ target: M.vec.add(W.figureAt(9), [0, 1.3, 0]), dist: 4, az: -95, el: 3, pull: 6, mm: 40, dur: 9 })

shots.name: Return to the opening frame
shots.use: Bookend: end on the frame the film opened with, now changed.
shots.recipe: M.reverse(M.craneReveal({ target: W.tower, dist: 120, az: 30, rise: 26, mm: 24, dur: 8 }))

shots.name: Fade-hold on the object
shots.use: Locked close on the object while the light falls: the evidence remains.
shots.recipe: M.lockOff({ target: W.object, dist: 1.3, az: 35, el: 10, mm: 85, drift: 0.01, dur: 8 })

shots.name: Ridge-line departure
shots.use: Fly back over the ridge, leaving the place behind it: exit the world of the story.
shots.recipe: M.reverse(M.droneRidgeReveal({ crest: W.ridge.crest, dir: W.ridge.dir, vista: W.plaza, back: 30, low: 8, clear: 10, ahead: 40, mm: 24, dur: 9 }))

shots.name: Credits drift
shots.use: A slow lateral drift over the world under end cards: calm, cheap, unhurried.
shots.recipe: M.truck({ target: W.plaza, dist: 180, az: 40, el: 12, track: 40, mm: 50, dur: 14, ease: 'gentle' })
